content.text:
A recent headline about artificial intelligence is:

**"Protesters break into Microsoft data center site in Amsterdam as Europe's backlash spreads"**

This article reports on activists entering a Microsoft data center construction site in Amsterdam, highlighting growing opposition across Europe to large-scale data center projects due to concerns over energy consumption and environmental impact. ([apnews.com](https://apnews.com/article/b4f3f9f368697bb37416bcb4fabdd67c?utm_source=openai))
